headline: Maui Cultural Resources Commission

meeting.summary: Commissioners approved the old county courthouse renovation plans by voice vote.
meeting.recap: Commissioners approved the old county courthouse renovation plans by voice vote.[[0:26:02]] The commission voted five in favor to allow food and merchandise sales in public spaces for the event.[[1:09:44]] Their representative asked the commission to remove its earlier requests for a cultural impact study and burial council review.[[2:13:21]] The commission voted five in favor to defer the item to no later than its September 3rd meeting.[[3:16:24]] With too few eligible voters, the commission could not comment on an archaeological survey plan for a highway realignment.[[3:42:09]] The planned highway route crosses 17 known archaeological sites.[[3:59:59]] That item was deferred to the August 6th meeting.[[4:20:12]] The meeting ended for lack of a quorum before the director's report.[[4:20:50]]
decided: The highway survey plan item was deferred to August 6th without a vote because too few members could act.
meeting.next: The courthouse project will go to bid once its building permit is approved. Staff confirmed the owners' representative will get a letter outlining the motion. The wastewater presenter asked that any comments go to him or a Department of Health contact. The highway presentation will be linked on the agenda.
